description: This file implements security-related functionalities including token validation, user allowlist checks, DM authorization, input sanitization, and a rate limiter class for managing request rates per user.

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: A sliding window rate limiter class that manages request limits per user ID.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a webhook token using constant-time comparison, rejecting empty tokens.

methods.name: checkUserAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user ID is in the allowed list, which must be explicitly non-empty.

methods.name: authorizeUserForDm
methods.description: Determines if a user is authorized for direct messaging based on the DM policy and allowlist.

methods.name: sanitizeInput
methods.description: Sanitizes user input to prevent prompt injection, filtering dangerous patterns and truncating long messages.
